title: auth/store: bcrypt timing equalization fails for empty store
description: crates/auth/src/store.rs make_dummy_hash() falls back to bcrypt::DEFAULT_COST when no hashes are configured. CredentialStore::empty() is the case where the store has zero users. When from_credentials() is called with a non-empty list the dummy hash is computed at the correct cost, but if a caller constructs a store with from_credentials(&[]) (empty slice), make_dummy_hash also uses DEFAULT_COST — correct. However if CredentialStore::empty() is used in a code path where AUTH is still attempted (dev_mode = false but no users), the dummy hash cost may differ from a separately-configured production store used in parallel, leaking whether the empty-store or non-empty-store path is taken. Low-probability, but the timing contract is broken in that edge case.
